text:
maria: ap-south warm pool started failing 03:12 UTC, nodes not joining cluster, started after last firewall push.
tyler: saw that, control-plane logs show TLS handshake timeout to node agent 10.12.5.78
maria: exact change was firewall: deny 10.0.0.0/8 added to infra-managed rule-set to block legacy backhauls
nina: ah — our node agents talk to control plane on privip range 10.x, so that's blocked
raj: ops-bot just created incident INC-842, tagging eng-sre and eng-security
ops-bot: incident INC-842 created by maria — priority P2 — link: https://internal.incidents/INC-842 :rotating_light:
maria: immediate mitigation: revert rule or add exception for subnet 10.12.0.0/16? which is safer?
tyler: revert asap, but firewall change was to plug data exfil path. suggest add narrow allow for node-ctrl port 15010 and kms egress
nina: node-ctrl port is 15010/TCP, kms uses 443 to egress endpoints. we need logging to show egress hits
maria: rolling revert in progress — patching fw-manage -> runbook snippet:

```bash
fwctl rollback --change 9876 --force
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/node-agent -n infra
```

maria: applied rollback at 03:32 UTC
deploybot: firewall-change-9876 rollback succeeded on all 5 ap-south firewalls
tyler: nodes started reconnecting. journalctl shows: "agent: handshake complete, control-plane 10.1.2.3:15010"
raj: but some GPU instances kept preempting due to failed bootstraps, looks like init script timed out waiting for KMS decrypt
nina: KMS calls were failing earlier because TLS to kms internal proxy was also on 10.x and blocked
maria: root cause: overbroad deny of RFC1918 range applied to infra-managed firewall instead of edge-lists
tyler: impact: ~18% of ap-south GPU capacity unavailable for 20 minutes, queued jobs retried on other regions incurring $4.3k extra cost
raj: logging: need to add an audit alert when firewall rule touches RFC1918/10.* ranges; escalate to eng-security for policy
nina: also recommend changing bootstrap to fallback to cached key for 2 retries before KMS reachback
maria: action items:
- add narrow allow for 10.12.0.0/16 and kms proxies
- add firewall-change preflight test that queries node-agent ports
- create audit rule for RFC1918 denies
- postmortem doc
raj: assigning owners: maria (mitigation), nina (bootstrap fallback), tyler (cost calc + alert), raj (postmortem)
maria: will schedule 1h follow-up 08:00 UTC, notify customers with affected SLAs
tyler: FYI, made a quick cost calc: cross-region retries ~$4.3k, saving would be to enable 2-min local queue and soft-fail rather than requeue
nina: note for infra-runbooks: add small iptables snippet to allow 10.12.0.0/16 for node agents
maria: thanks all. closing the incident once postmortem template filled. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident INC-842 updated — status: mitigated — owner: maria
maria: creating postmortem link: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-842
